capabilities: fetch Jira issue fields using the note filename as the issue key
write Jira field values into note frontmatter via configurable mappings
build note aliases from fetched Jira fields using templates
insert the Jira issue URL into note content
sync frontmatter for notes in a custom Bases view
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian can't pull Jira issue data into note properties, so users must manually copy fields like summary and status into frontmatter.

relations.evidence: Fetches Jira issue fields for a note based on the note's filename.

summary: Jira integration that fetches issue fields for notes named after issue keys and writes them into frontmatter.
